scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a 3D model, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms. Make every placeholder real rock, scrub, plaster, stone and tile. The trading house is a finished model: keep every modelled column drum, flagstone, door board, rafter, roof tile, rubble stone and the slotted timber board on its wall exactly where it is, only giving each its real weathered material: lime plaster, grey limestone, timber, terracotta. Add no doors, windows, shelves or racks; the columns stay plain, never fluted. Earth road. Winter overcast, soft flat light, no hard shadows. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its messenger and pouch exactly. Two messengers (bare-headed, ochre exomis, hide pera at hip) reach the gate at the same moment from opposite ends of the road in front of the portico, each holding out one narrow papyrus slip toward the gate. A bored loader in a plain undyed tunic leans in the open storehouse doorway. Each blank tag over the board's slots carries one painted Greek letter-numeral (Α, Β, Γ…), never Arabic digits. Deep focus. No other people. Nothing modern.
